purpose: Two new entrance atlases sharing the approved Juzi poses; original sprites preserved

prompts.pudding:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a new transparent PNG game sprite key-pose sheet derived from image 1. Keep its exact two-panel layout, camera, shapes, pose silhouettes, scale and spacing. Image 1 is the approved ORANGE Juzi opening animation sheet; replace Juzi in BOTH poses with PUDDING from the MIDDLE of image 2. Image 2 defines Pudding's approved identity and NEW swimwear; image 3 defines her pixel sprite style and ring design ONLY, do not use its old shirt/collar/sleeves.
Output ONE sheet, same landscape 2:1 composition, ideally 1774x887. Left: airborne character upper-left reaching diagonally down-right toward the detached EMPTY ring in lower-center left panel, her knees folded and bare feet trailing backward. There must be a clear transparent gap between hands and ring. Right: same character landing inside the hole, leaning forward, elbows bent, BOTH hands on the near rim, body down through opening and legs hidden behind near rim, eyes happily squeezed closed. Keep body/head registration and ring dimensions very close to image 1 because these poses will use the very same animation paths.
PUDDING: cream/light beige short hair with chocolate-brown lower locks, rounded side bunches with yellow ribbon ties, brown cat ears, large sapphire blue eyes, a tiny caramel pudding hair ornament, brown-and-cream cat tail with yellow bow, and the LITTLE SIAMESE kitten clinging to the crown in BOTH poses. Kitten must stay attached to the head. Wardrobe exactly the MIDDLE of image 2: yellow-and-cream TWO-PIECE swimsuit, delicate thin shoulder straps, brown central bow and tiny pudding motif on top, separate matching swim bottom with brown side ties, clearly exposed midriff, no collar, no sleeves, barefoot. Non-suggestive cute chibi mascot.
Ring becomes yellow-and-cream with small caramel-brown accents and a small pudding emblem on the near rim, like image 3, but keep the same physically hollow ring shape and near/far thickness of image 1. LEFT EMPTY ring hole must be genuinely transparent, no bottom, no water filling, no boat. No splashes, water, scenery, text, arrows, panels, cast shadows or extra objects.
Art: crisp hand-pixelled game sprite, chunky stair-step pixel boundaries and dark brown outline, limited clustered pixel shading matching image 1 and image 3, bright cute anime face. No vector curves, blur or painterly gradients. Preserve the TWO different motion poses, do not draw two standing portraits.
prompts.milkcap:
